neighbours.label: contrasting or listing alternative software tools in technical prose (like A or B; X while Y is a ...)
fire: For state management you can choose libraries like Zustand or Jotai.
Postgres is a relational database, while Redis is an in-memory store.
Teams often deploy with tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
Unlike Webpack, Vite serves source files over native ES modules.
You could write the service in Go or Rust, depending on your team.
Git is a version control system, whereas GitHub is a hosting platform.
Charts can be drawn with D3 or with a simpler library like Chart.js.
Jenkins is self-hosted while CircleCI runs in the cloud.
quiet: For state management we store everything in a single global object.
The database stores customer orders and is backed up every night.
Our team deploys the application every Tuesday afternoon.
The build step bundles all source files into a single script.
The service is written in a compiled language and runs on Linux.
Every change to the code is reviewed by another developer.
The dashboard shows a chart of daily sales for the last month.
The pipeline runs all the tests whenever someone pushes a commit.

notes: Card: no single token; peaks on ' or', ' is', ' a' in software comparisons ('render props or hooks', 'while WordPress is a CMS'). Probe: such sentences 0.32-0.38, unrelated prose 0.02. Near misses keep the software topic without a comparison.
